description: This Python source file defines several API endpoints for managing budget entities in a system. It includes functions for creating, updating, retrieving info, listing, configuring settings, and deleting budgets via FastAPI routes. The endpoints interact with a database through Prisma client and enforce authorization policies.

classes.name: BudgetNewRequest
classes.description: Data model representing a request to create or update a budget, including fields like budget_duration, budget_id, max_budget, soft_budget, and others.

classes.name: BudgetRequest
classes.description: Data model used for retrieving budget information, notably containing a list of budget IDs.

classes.name: BudgetDeleteRequest
classes.description: Data model for requesting deletion of a specific budget by ID.

classes.name: ConfigList
classes.description: Structure for returning configuration options with details like field name, type, description, current value, and defaults.

methods.name: new_budget( budget_obj: BudgetNewRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Creates a new budget record in the database, setting an initial reset time if applicable.

methods.name: update_budget( budget_obj: BudgetNewRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates an existing budget record identified by budget_id with new parameters.

methods.name: info_budget(data: BudgetRequest)
methods.description: Retrieves information on specified budgets based on provided IDs.

methods.name: budget_settings( budget_id: str, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Returns configurable settings for a budget, including current values and descriptions, used mainly on admin UIs.

methods.name: list_budget( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Lists all budgets stored in the database, accessible to admin users.

methods.name: delete_budget( data: BudgetDeleteRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes a specified budget by ID from the database, restricted to admin users.
